name: 3D Gaussian Ellipsoid Rendering
aliases: Differentiable Volume Renderer using Gaussian Ellipsoids
VoGE Ray Tracing with Ellipsoidal Gaussians
VoGE: A Differentiable Volume Renderer using Gaussian Ellipsoids for Analysis-by-Synthesis
definition: VoGE is a differentiable volume renderer that uses 3D Gaussian ellipsoids as geometric primitives to represent object geometry, replacing rasterization with ray tracing to capture volume density distributions for blending.
